name: com.airedteamingservices/site
title: AI Red Teaming Services
description: Search and read airedteamingservices.com and find how to contact Excession Labs. Reading needs no key; request_pentest sends an AI application assessment request and requires an agent key.

tools.name: search_site
tools.title: Search airedteamingservices.com
tools.description: Search the guides, service pages and research on airedteamingservices.com. Returns titles, URLs and one-line summaries.

tools.name: get_page
tools.title: Read a page as Markdown
tools.description: Return the Markdown text of a page on airedteamingservices.com, given its path (for example /guides/).

tools.name: how_to_contact
tools.title: How to contact Excession Labs
tools.description: Return the form URL and email address a person can use to contact Excession Labs. This tool does not send anything.

tools.name: request_pentest
tools.title: Request a security test from Excession Labs
tools.description: Send a request for a penetration test or an AI application security assessment to Excession Labs on behalf of a person who asked for it. Needs an agent key (POST /agent/auth, then Authorization: Bearer <key>). Excession Labs replies to the person by email to agree scope; testing starts only after a written scope and written authorization from the system owner. Never include passwords, API keys or customer data. Limits: 5 requests a day per key, 3 a day per email address.
